technical.summary: Mixed signals with long-term trend support (50/200 EMA bullish) but conflicting intermediate-term weakness (price below 21/50 EMAs, below Ichimoku cloud, negative CMF) and no active strategy triggers make this a low-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 18 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and stale trading data (2+ years old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (344.64), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and CPI event just passed create severe macro headwinds; earnings in 18 days adds binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA structure (50/200 bullish) + Supertrend bullish + extreme fear sentiment (34/100) create contrarian setup near support (72.56) with asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all intermediate moving averages (21/50 EMA), below Ichimoku cloud, negative CMF, zero strategy triggers, high earnings risk in 18 days, crisis VIX, and rising dollar create a toxic macro environment with no institutional conviction or insider support.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term EMA bullish structure and extreme fear sentiment (34/100) offer contrarian appeal, but price is trapped below all intermediate moving averages with negative CMF and zero strategy triggers, creating weak entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 18 days combined with crisis VIX (344.64), rising dollar headwind, and macro deterioration create binary event risk with no institutional or insider conviction to support the position.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weakness; bear case dominates with high confidence
decision.portfolio_note: Already 2 positions open in Energy sector; adding MPC increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without conviction signals to justify it.
